body.condition: For every selectable recursive layout and every \(0\le j<H_n\), each population terminal state advanced \(j\) times by a valid population recurrence belongs to \(\operatorname{col}(\bar Z_{\mathrm{rec},n})\).

novel.justification: This is a selected-layout strengthening of Shen's recursive recovery condition. It is satisfied by persistent harmonic, polynomial, and exponential factor sequences when each deterministic candidate Page block spans the common recurrence space, and it can be screened by predeclared span diagnostics.
